matchUrls.title: Match URLs or ids
matchUrls.description: Flashscore match pages in any URL form (https://www.flashscore.com/match/j52jHsN8/, the long .../match/football/brighton-2XrRecc3/arsenal-hA1Zm19f/?mid=j52jHsN8 form, or any Flashscore edition), or bare 8-character match ids.
matchUrls.sectionDescription: Any mix of single matches, leagues and teams. Leagues and teams give their newest finished matches; set how many below.

leagueUrls.title: League or season URLs
leagueUrls.description: A league page for the current season (https://www.flashscore.com/football/england/premier-league/) or a past season (.../premier-league-2024-2025/). Sub-pages such as .../results/ work too.

teamUrls.title: Team URLs
teamUrls.description: A team page, e.g. https://www.flashscore.com/team/arsenal/hA1Zm19f/. Gives the team's newest finished matches in every competition.

maxMatchesPerSource.title: Matches per league or team
maxMatchesPerSource.description: Newest finished matches to scrape from each league or team URL. 0 = every finished match (a whole Premier League season is 380).

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: Only league and team matches played on or after this day (UTC), e.g. 2026-08-01.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Only league and team matches played on or before this day (UTC).

include.title: Data to collect
include.description: Every match row has the score, period scores, incidents (goals, cards, substitutions), referee, venue and attendance. Team statistics: every stat per period (xG, possession, shots ...). Lineups: one row per player with shirt number, position, rating and substitutions, plus formations and coaches. Player stats: about 100 stats per footballer (xG, xA, passes, duels, tackles ...) or the box score in basketball and hockey, added to the player rows. Missing players: injured and suspended players. Momentum: per-minute pressure graph (football). Commentary: the full text commentary. Head-to-head: both teams' recent matches and their previous meetings.

includeUnusedSubstitutes.title: Include unused substitutes
includeUnusedSubstitutes.description: Also add a player row for substitutes who did not come on.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Stop after this many dataset rows in total (match rows plus player rows).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed: Flashscore does not block by IP. The Actor escalates to Apify proxies automatically if it is ever refused.
